metadata.title: OpenZap — Free WhatsApp Link & QR Code Generator
metadata.description: Generate WhatsApp click-to-chat links and downloadable QR codes with prefilled messages, UTM tracking, and more. Free, privacy-friendly, no sign-up.

hero.title: Generate WhatsApp links & QR codes
hero.subtitle: Craft a click-to-chat URL with a prefilled message, UTM tracking, and a downloadable QR code. Everything runs in your browser — we never see your data.

wa.label: Standard link
wa.description: Universal wa.me URL — works on every device.

api.label: Tracked (UTM)
api.description: api.whatsapp.com URL that supports UTM parameters for analytics.

deepLink.label: App deep link
deepLink.description: whatsapp:// deep link — only opens if the app is installed.

web.label: Web only
web.description: web.whatsapp.com URL — forces the web client on desktop.

shortCode.label: Business short code
shortCode.description: wa.me/message/[CODE] — uses a WhatsApp Business short link.

phone.label: Phone number
phone.help: International format. Country code is added automatically.
phone.invalid: Enter a valid phone number for the selected country.
phone.required: Phone number is required for this variant.

shortCode.label: Short code
shortCode.help: The code appears after wa.me/message/ in your business link.
shortCode.invalid: Only letters and digits are allowed.

message.label: Message
message.placeholder: Hi, I saw your website and...
message.help: Up to 4,096 characters. Newlines are preserved.

preview.title: Result
preview.chatHint: This is how your prefilled message will look on WhatsApp.

url.title: Generated URL
url.openHint: Opens the WhatsApp app or WhatsApp Web.

footer.trademark: WhatsApp is a trademark of Meta Platforms, Inc. OpenZap is not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta.

feedback.title: Share feedback
feedback.description: Found a bug, have an idea, or want to say hi? We'd love to hear from you.
feedback.messagePlaceholder: Tell us what's on your mind…
feedback.success: Thanks! Your feedback has been sent.
feedback.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
